study: spec 025: long engagements, a registered study (E1 carry non-inferiority, E2 cost of an untended contact, E3 the IMM's drift)
written_after: experiments/20261118-ls-tuning/ (seed 349); before seeds 350 and 351 have been generated

rules.soundness (validation; a failure stops t: S1 >= 95% of contact 1's planned windows ran and no engagement missing; S2 ctl / true-history fit (pooled median, contact 1) in [0.8, 4]; S3 contact 1's bearings held in [0.6, 0.95]
rules.E1: geometric mean over windows of (median error ctl / median error ctl-carry), contact 1, 95% bootstrap interval over engagements (2,000, seed 25); ctl-carry non-inferior if the lower limit >= 0.95; then carrying is adopted for long chains as a cost measure, otherwise not
rules.E2: geometric mean over range bands (2-10, 10-20, 20-40 km; >= 50 rows on both contacts) of median ctl error contact 2 / contact 1; a magnitude, no rule
rules.E3: IMM median error in hours 6-12 / hours 0-6 on the 12-hour engagements, contact 1; drift shown if the interval lies wholly above 1

conditions_can_fire.E1: tuning 1.054 [0.955, 1.177] on 12 engagements; at 60 the half-width is about 0.05, so the lower limit clears 0.95 if the estimate is above about 1.00 and fails below it
conditions_can_fire.E3: tuning 0.77 [0.51, 1.31] on 6 engagements; at 30 the half-width is about 0.18, so drift is shown if the estimate exceeds about 1.2

forecasts.soundness: passes (tuning: 72 of 72 windows; ctl / reference 1.40; bearings held 0.85)
forecasts.E1: non-inferior, about three in four: the per-window median ratio is 1.00 and the tuning mean 1.05 rests on a few windows twice better
forecasts.E2: about 1.2 to 1.4 with an interval including 1: once range is matched, most of spec 024's three-to-fivefold cost is geometry
forecasts.E3: no drift shown: tuning's early hours are worse, not its late ones

known_limits: realism parameters are spec 024's choices, not measured
E2 confounds geometry with tending by design; banding by range removes only part of the geometry (bearing rate and ownship manoeuvres relative to the contact are not matched)
E3 reads one IMM tuning (MAN2's) and starts it after the first ownship turn; drift could be the tuning's
E1's 0.95 margin is a choice; the owner may set another before validation
the tuning seed's figures are restated in the forecasts; they are not independent predictions
CI runners' CPU family can differ between jobs (spec 024: kilometres on a window); E1 pairs ctl and ctl-carry within one job, E2 compares two jobs' outputs, E3 one job
